findings.body: This branch adds plans/CWF-7.md, plans/CWF-7.read.md, and two .factory/stories/CWF-7 records outside T1A's allowed paths. These files do not deliver the removal table or shared helpers. Move those changes to the story setup change or remove them from this part.
findings.title: Keep story records and plans out of the scoped API part

findings.body: T1A exercises endMembership through the application service. T1D owns the leave endpoint and its end-to-end proof that the last member's departure invalidates the old link and keeps usage rows, plus the leave-versus-join race. Those checks cannot run through the endpoint in this part.
findings.title: Later: T1D must prove last-member deletion through leave

findings.body: The deletion helper erases removal blocks, but T1A's test creates no block. T1B owns the removal endpoint, the endpoint proof that a block disappears when the last member later leaves, and the removal-versus-join and removal-versus-leave races.
findings.title: Later: T1B must prove block erasure and removal races

findings.body: The new race test proves that invite reset rejects an old admin after a handover simulated by a database update. T1C owns the handover action and the remaining endpoint races between handover, admin departure, and an old admin's action.
findings.title: Later: T1C must prove handover races for admin actions
